success_conditions: No 'error' or 'unable to' strings in log
failure_conditions: Missing ELF metadata or truncated disassembly output
iaos.notes: Runs on every IA64 binary; logs stored under build/logs/iaos/<name>.log

failure_conditions: Early termination before reaching min bundle count (default 10k) unless binary is tiny
iaka.notes: Adjust -m per binary category; emits optional trace via -t options when requested.

success_conditions: Exit status 0 *or* graceful trap with stats header
Stats output includes IPC and instruction counts
iaio.notes: Treat architectural traps (e.g., OS syscall faults) as expected but record them.

success_conditions: Exit status 0 with stats OR known fault signature recorded
Log contains resource stats or explicit fault reason
iaoo.notes: Many bare-metal binaries fault on missing OS services; capture the fault but consider it a soft pass.

success_conditions: Successfully parses a trace emitted by IAKA/IAIO/IAOO
Outputs statistics table or confirmation message
failure_conditions: Cannot open trace generated moments earlier
iata.notes: Only run when a trace is available; skip/mark N/A when upstream tool did not produce one.
